Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)]]: a close-up of the tattoo on Cher's backside, from the photograph of her on stage at Wembley Arena, London, in 1992 ([[:File:Joke reference - Cher from behind at Wembley Arena 1992.jpg]]). 400 by 400 pixels.

Photo: Brian Rasic/REX Features (Shutterstock), Wembley Arena, London, 1992 (agency reference 199891B). Close-up supplied by Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small detail of a press photograph, showing the tattoo that the card's lore jokes about. It is used only to identify that reference beside the card on [[Jokes]], with full credit to the photographer and agency. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
